nodes.name: Manifest Webhook
nodes.notes:
SITE MANIFEST WRITE (the validated line-up the reader trusts)
POST /webhook/site/manifest-npj
Authorization: Bearer <matrix token>
Body: { identifier:'npj-site', filename:'manifest.json', manifest:{ v, updated, articles:[...] } }
Gate: Matrix admin/editor (same roles as publish). PUTs the manifest JSON to the
archive.org item we own (npj-site/manifest.json, overwrite). Because only this
path can write that item, the reader trusts a slug iff it is listed here —
so a stranger who self-tags an upload `npj-article` never enters the site.
The client (app/record/articles.js → publishManifest) sends the FULL manifest,
so this is a plain overwrite — no server-side merge, no half-merged races.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: ($json.error || 'unauthorized'), user: $json.user_id || null, role: $json.role || null }) }}

nodes.name: Manifest IA Put
nodes.notes: Reuses the IA S3 keys (same as the publish flow's mirror). Overwrites npj-site/manifest.json.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.ok, url: $json.url, error: $json.error, identifier: $json.identifier, filename: $json.filename, count: $json.count }) }}
